none: PAS NMGW-D725C3: Roman silver ring, 3rd century
contea di ritrovamento: Newport (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman silver finger ring, probably of 3rd century AD date The finger ring is complete and is comparatively large with an internal diameter of 22.82mm (27.55mm external) and weighing 11.5g. The ring has a width of 9.63mm and is composed of ten concave panels or facets (4.1mm long) separated by rounded ribs. Each of the panels contains a stamped letter: V T E (rev.) R E (rev.) F E(rev.) L I X…
